meta.title: Dremu Chart Studio
meta.description: A full-page chart studio for Gorge / Dremu .g chart projects: timeline editing, an inspector, curve editors, multi-clip audio periods, playback, and undo/redo, reading and writing the .g staff files on disk; the agent can edit the same chart with the gorge_chart_get / gorge_chart_edit tools and changes appear live in the editor.
